An 18-year-old man and a woman were rescued by the Kothanur police after they allegedly attempted to end their lives by consuming pesticide inside a closed college campus in north Bengaluru on October 28. The individuals are now out of danger.
According to the police, the incident reportedly occurred over their relationship. It came to light after the man called his parents and informed them that both had consumed pesticide. His father subsequently contacted the Namma 112 emergency helpline and sought assistance.
On receiving the alert, Namma 112 personnel immediately informed a head constable of Kothanur Police Station. A police officer on a Hoysala bike reached the spot within a few minutes and, with the assistance of students from another college, found the duo in a corner of the closed college premises.
The police personnel immediately shifted them to a nearby hospital with the assistance of a few more students. The parents of the victims were later informed. Both were handed over to their respective families after treatment, police said.
(If you are in distress or having suicidal tendencies, please reach out to these helplines: TeleMANAS at 1-8008914416/ 14416, NIMHANS at 08026685948, 9480829670 or SAHAI at 080 25497777, +91-9886444075)
